development_population.role: mechanism/integrity diagnostic only; no tuning permitted

global_verdict_rule: PASS iff c1 through c6 all hold on the frozen final population
hard_invariants: composition masks may only deactivate matched active residual bits
no composition arm may activate an inactive residual bit
R0.4 final population remains unopened until source/tests freeze
negative_pair_only: retain only PRECEDES and INTERFACE_TERMINAL; secondary diagnostic

positive_core.operation: retain only currently-active matched residual bits belonging to CROSS_LANE_ROUTE, MEMORY_SPAN, or CONSTRAINT_AFTER

positive_core_count_control.distinctness: when an alternative subset exists, removal must differ from the exact PRECEDES+INTERFACE_TERMINAL removal set
positive_core_count_control.operation: remove exactly the same number of currently-active bits as positive_core removes, using deterministic SHA-256 ordering over the full active matched residual

reintroduction_arms.positive_plus_INTERFACE_TERMINAL: positive core plus INTERFACE_TERMINAL; PRECEDES excluded
reintroduction_arms.positive_plus_PRECEDES: positive core plus PRECEDES; INTERFACE_TERMINAL excluded

scientific_question: Does the positively localized residual subspace from R0.3 constitute a sufficient and composition-specific guidance signal, and do the two negative-direction families degrade that signal when reintroduced?

search_contract.rng_pairing: fresh identical Random(base_seed + fixture_index) per arm
